units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 5:1:8">Y. Shek. V, 48ᵈ</cite> top <he>הרי זו ח׳</he> that is a wise court; <cite ref="Sanhedrin 17b:3">Snh. 17ᵇ</cite> <he>שלישית ח׳</he> a Sanhedrin containing three orators is a wise one.
<cite ref="Mishnah Rosh Hashanah 2:5">R. Hash. II, 5</cite>; <cite ref="Eruvin 45a:7">Erub. 45ᵃ</cite> <he>ח׳ הבאה לילד</he> a midwife called for assisting at birth.
<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 18:3">Sabb. XVIII, 3</cite> <he>וקורין לה ח׳ וכ׳</he> and we must call for her a midwife from another place (on the Sabbath); a. fr.
